lessons.name: ode_to_joy
lessons.title: Ode to Joy
lessons.instructions: The whole melody sits in the right hand's C position. Bars 4 and 8 have a dotted rhythm, long-short: count 'one-and-two-and' and play the short note on the 'and' of two.
tips: Play the repeated notes evenly — same finger, same weight.
The left hand alternates between C (finger 5) and G (thumb).
